# Vendored Dashboard Dependencies

These browser dependencies are served locally for offline dashboard use.

| File | Version | License | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `d3-hierarchy.min.js` | 3.1.2 | ISC; see `d3-hierarchy.LICENSE` | https://github.com/d3/d3-hierarchy |
| `lucide.min.js` | 1.8.0 | ISC with MIT-derived Feather icons; see `lucide.LICENSE` | https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide |

The D3 license was retrieved from the published 3.1.2 package at
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-hierarchy@3.1.2/LICENSE.
The Lucide bundle and license were copied without modification from the
installed `lucide` 1.8.0 package.
